clips.title: The story
paras: Alliance recruits enter Icewing Cavern to earn the Stormpike Banner. The trial lies southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley, where harpies guard the standard.

Lieutenant Haggerdin sends new Alliance soldiers into Icewing Cavern southwest of Dun Baldar. Before they face the Frostwolf orcs, recruits must brave the harpies, seize the Stormpike Banner, and bring it back alive. Those who return earn the rank and insignia of an initiate in the Stormpike Guard.
